XData.name: ProductionDefinition
XData.Data:
<Production Name="Example.Alerting.Production" TestingEnabled="false" LogGeneralTraceEvents="false"> <Description>Canonical alert circuit (per §7.1).</Description> <ActorPoolSize>2</ActorPoolSize>
<!-- ProductionMonitorService — heartbeat for the production health --> <Item Name="Ens.ProductionMonitorService" Category="Alerting" ClassName="Ens.MonitorService" PoolSize="1" Enabled="true" Foreground="false" Comment="§1.6 baseline" LogTraceEvents="false" Schedule=""> </Item>
<!-- Ens.Alert routing engine — Send Alert on Error MUST be DISABLED here --> <Item Name="Ens.Alert" Category="Alerting" ClassName="EnsLib.MsgRouter.RoutingEngine" PoolSize="1" Enabled="true" Foreground="false" Comment="Routes Ens.AlertRequest to the email operation; dedup rules attached." LogTraceEvents="false" Schedule=""> <Setting Target="Host" Name="AlertOnError">0</Setting> <Setting Target="Host" Name="BusinessRuleName">Example.Alerting.RUL.AlertRouter</Setting> </Item>
<!-- AlertOperation — Send Alert on Error MUST be DISABLED here --> <Item Name="EnsLib.EMail.AlertOperation" Category="Alerting" ClassName="EnsLib.EMail.AlertOperation" PoolSize="1" Enabled="true" Foreground="false" Comment="Sends Ens.AlertRequest messages to the distribution list." LogTraceEvents="false" Schedule=""> <Setting Target="Host" Name="AlertOnError">0</Setting> <Setting Target="Adapter" Name="SMTPServer">smtp.example.org</Setting> <Setting Target="Adapter" Name="Recipient">interop-alerts@example.org</Setting> </Item>
<!-- An ORDINARY business host, and the reason the circuit above ever fires. AlertOnError=1 is what turns a failure here into the Ens.AlertRequest that Ens.Alert routes. Every host in a real production except Ens.Alert and the alert sink looks like this one. --> <Item Name="BO.DemoOutbound" Category="Demo" ClassName="EnsLib.HL7.Operation.TCPOperation" PoolSize="1" Enabled="true" Foreground="false" Comment="Ordinary BO: feeds the alert circuit." LogTraceEvents="false" Schedule=""> <Setting Target="Host" Name="AlertOnError">1</Setting> <Setting Target="Host" Name="QueueWaitAlert">30</Setting> <Setting Target="Host" Name="FailureTimeout">30</Setting> <Setting Target="Adapter" Name="IPAddress">hl7.example.org</Setting> <Setting Target="Adapter" Name="Port">5000</Setting> </Item>
</Production>

XData.name: RuleDefinition
XData.Data: <ruleDefinition alias="" context="EnsLib.MsgRouter.RoutingEngine" production="Example.Alerting.Production"> <ruleSet name="Default" effectiveBegin="" effectiveEnd=""> <rule name="dedupBySession" disabled="false"> <when condition='##class(Demo.FilterAlerts.FunctionSet).AlreadyReportedPerSession()=1'> <!-- skip: this session has already produced an alert --> <return>0</return> </when> </rule> <rule name="dedupByErrText" disabled="false"> <when condition='##class(Demo.FilterAlerts.FunctionSet).AlreadyReportedErr(Document.SourceConfigName,Document.AlertText,60)=1'> <!-- skip: same error text already reported in this time bucket --> <return>0</return> </when> </rule> <rule name="forward" disabled="false"> <when condition="1"> <send transform="" target="EnsLib.EMail.AlertOperation"/> </when> </rule> </ruleSet> </ruleDefinition>
